match.pattern: ^dear customer,\s+your account has been blocked by an amount of\s+(?:rs\.?|inr|₹)\s*(?<amt>\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,2})?),\s*against the upi one[- ]time mandate\s*-\s*icici bank\.?\s*$

examples.body: Dear Customer, your account has been blocked by an amount of Rs.14250, against the UPI one-time mandate-ICICI Bank.
Dear Customer, your account has been debited by an amount of Rs.14250, against the UPI one-time mandate-ICICI Bank.

match.pattern: ^dear customer,\s+your account has been unblocked by an amount of\s+(?:rs\.?|inr|₹)\s*(?<amt>\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,2})?),\s*against the upi one[- ]time mandate\s*-\s*icici bank\.?\s*$

examples.body: Dear Customer, your account has been unblocked by an amount of Rs.14250, against the UPI one-time mandate-ICICI Bank.
Dear Customer, your account has been debited by an amount of Rs.14250, against the UPI one-time mandate-ICICI Bank.
